snippet.title: Ashbane - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4315510/Ashbane/

Ashbane is a turn-based tactical RPG where you lead a mercenary guild in a world that rewards power and punishes mistakes. Recruit and customize your warband, take on dangerous jobs or strike at rival guilds, and lead expeditions where every encounter has lasting consequences.
